mapper.sql: request_id, kind, date_from, date_to, notify_email, status, row_count, file_name, base_url, one_time_uuid, requested_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_requests (request_id, kind, date_from, date_to, notify_email, status, base_url, one_time_uuid, requested_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{kind}, #{dateFrom}, #{dateTo}, #{notifyEmail}, #{status}, #{baseUrl}, #{oneTimeUuid}, #{requestedAt})
mapper.select: UPDATE export_requests SET status = 'PROCESSING' WHERE request_id = ( SELECT request_id FROM export_requests WHERE status = 'QUEUED' AND requested_at < #{notBefore} ORDER BY requested_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE export_requests SET status = #{status}, row_count = #{rowCount}, file_name = #{fileName}, completed_at = now() WHERE request_id = #{requestId}
